title: Sự thật về rạn da — Đây không phải cách bạn nghĩ
script: 90% phụ nữ có rạn da. Không phải vì bạn béo hay gầy. Rạn da là kết quả của sự thay đổi nhanh — dậy thì, tăng cân, mang thai, tập gym tăng cơ nhanh. Retinol, dầu dừa, kem dưỡng — tất cả chỉ làm mờ bề mặt 20%. Sự thật? Rạn da không bao giờ biến mất hoàn toàn. Nhưng bạn có thể làm cho chúng ít nhìn thấy hơn bằng tretinoin, laser, và quan trọng nhất — chấp nhận cơ thể. Body positivity không phải từ bỏ fitness. Mà là yêu cơ thể đang thay đổi mỗi ngày.
prompt_for_hailuo: Beautiful confident fitness girl in sports bra, relaxed and proud, natural daylight [Close up medium shot]. Skin close-up: stretch marks visible on stomach, then fading cream animation smoothing the tone [Macro skin texture shot]. Split screen: 'before' harsh lighting showing skin texture vs 'after' smooth confident pose. Skincare and body oil products on marble shelf [Flat lay overhead shot]. Girl looking in mirror with confident smile [Medium shot]. Soft natural light, warm empowering atmosphere, body positive tone, cinematic portrait 9:16.
thumbnail_idea: Confident fitness girl smiling in mirror — body positivity message, natural beauty
visual_scene: A warm and empowering scene with soft natural light flooding a bright modern bedroom, a beautiful confident Vietnamese fitness girl standing in front of a large mirror wearing a sports bra and leggings, her expression is relaxed and genuinely proud as she looks at her reflection with a warm confident smile. A skin close-up overlay shows stretch marks on stomach with an animated cream smoothing effect reducing their appearance by 20%. A split-screen shows harsh overhead lighting revealing skin texture on the left versus the same girl in soft flattering natural light with a smooth toned physique on the right. Premium skincare and body oil products in elegant bottles sit on a white marble shelf nearby. The overall tone is warm, empowering, and body-positive with soft natural lighting throughout, portrait 9:16 framing.
negative_prompt: generic anime or cartoon style, animated or illustrated characters, distorted hands or fingers, blurry or low resolution output, text overlays or captions, logos or watermarks, still or static frame, landscape orientation, dark dramatic lighting, sad or ashamed expression, comparison to other bodies, celebrity photos, diet product ads
specific_details: Warm empowering bright modern bedroom with soft natural light, beautiful confident Vietnamese fitness girl in sports bra and leggings looking at mirror reflection with genuinely proud relaxed smile, skin close-up overlay showing stretch marks with animated cream smoothing effect reducing appearance by 20%, split-screen harsh overhead lighting showing texture vs soft flattering natural light with smooth toned physique, premium skincare bottles on white marble shelf, warm empowering body-positive atmosphere, portrait 9:16.
